column1: # Values of Poinsett's code (the code of key_1814.tsv) from a contemporary interlinear decode: Poinsett to the Secretary of
# State, Buenos Aires, 29 June 1811, p. 2, two lines in code (19 groups) with the plain text written over them.
# Source: Historical Society of Pennsylvania, Joel R. Poinsett Papers (Gilpin collection), vol. 1, folder 10. Read from
# research photographs (not published). Plain text over the groups:
# "They have informed ^ me that some arms° are on the way from the U States at private contract"
# grade: D = word written over the group; S = syllable split of a decoded word (the split is ours).
# Marks: ^ after a group adds -ed (210^ = formed, as in "inform-ed"); the circle adds -s (204 = arm, "arms°").
